action: Compared the live opening clause to two complete digital Qurtubi presentations to test whether the English Mujahid belongs to the stored Arabic clause or to a separately worded Medinan-opinion clause.

source_anchors.locator: Page label 602; lines 23-28, especially the surah heading at line 24.
source_anchors.finding: KSU opening names Ibn Abbas, al-Kalbi, and Muqatil in the Makki opinion; the displayed opening does not include a Medinan-opinion sentence.

This fuller digital presentation prints two separate clauses: Makki according to Ibn Abbas/al-Kalbi/Muqatil, then Medinan according to al-Hasan/Ikrima/Mujahid/Qatada. Mujahid is attached to the second clause, not the first.
The opening likewise displays separate Makki and Medinan opinion lists, with Muqatil in the first and Mujahid in the second.

source_anchors.locator: Supabase rows 13239 (Arabic) and 38030 (English), surah 108 aya 1; source_url field 671.
source_anchors.finding: Arabic row contains only the opening three-name Makki clause; paired English starts by assigning Mujahid to it.

fidelity_result.mismatch: The live English opening's Mujahid appears to be clause assimilation from a separate Medinan sentence; it does not align to the exact stored Arabic opening.
fidelity_result.scope_guard: Correct only the mismatched opening name after independent review. Do not append the separately absent Medinan-opinion clause to live Arabic or English as part of this narrow correction.
fidelity_result.edition_guard: These are digital presentations; they do not by themselves identify which print edition KSU or the stored source used.

unresolved: Independent review remains necessary before any correction.
Exact print-edition provenance is not established by these web presentations.
Do not silently add the second Medinan-opinion clause absent from live Arabic.
next: Independent reviewer verifies the paired witnesses, the two clause boundary, and the proposed one-name correction. Keep production unchanged and preserve the separate Medinan opinion as absent from stored Arabic.
